weight_loss.name: Weight loss / fitness
weight_loss.description: Full body from several angles, with a timer for a propped-up phone.

hair.name: Hair treatment
hair.description: Hairline, temples, top, crown and nape, with a hands-free mode.

face.name: Facial treatment
face.description: Front, 45° and profiles, with a face guide.

custom.name: Custom
custom.description: You choose the name and the angles.

weight_loss.sameTime: Always shoot at the same time, ideally in the morning before eating.
weight_loss.sameConditions: Keep the same light, clothes and background.
weight_loss.distance: Prop the phone at belly-button height, about 2–3 m away.
weight_loss.posture: Relaxed posture; repeat the flexed pose too.

hair.dryClean: Dry, clean hair with no product and the same hairstyle.
hair.sameLight: Always use the same light — overhead light exaggerates thinning.
hair.interval: A 2–4 week interval shows progress best.
hair.crown: For crown and nape, use hands-free mode: the app vibrates and shoots by itself once the phone is level.

face.neutral: Neutral expression, looking at the camera.

custom.consistency: Repeat the same position, light and distance in every photo.

timeline.noEntriesDescription: Photos you take or import show up here.

timelineSettings.title: Configure timeline
timelineSettings.anglesHint: Disabled angles are hidden from capture, but old photos are kept.
timelineSettings.metricsHint: Values recorded at each check-in, like weight or measurements.
timelineSettings.deleteConfirmMessage: All photos and entries in this timeline will be permanently deleted.
timelineSettings.removeAngleConfirmMessage: Photos of this angle will be deleted too. To keep them, disable the angle instead.
timelineSettings.removeMetricConfirmMessage: Values already recorded for this metric will be deleted.
timelineSettings.lastAngle: The timeline needs at least one active angle.
